title: feat(site): serve a page as markdown when an agent asks for it
author: kreggscode

gist.summary: The homepage now returns a short Markdown summary for GET or HEAD requests that accept text/markdown, using its route title and description and pointing agents to gen.pollinations.ai/llms.txt. The Markdown response retains the agent-discovery Link headers and uses private caching; homepage HTML gains Vary: Accept because both formats share a URL. Other pages keep their full HTML, while assets and unknown routes retain their existing responses.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli wears tiny reading glasses and hands a neatly written Markdown page from a lime green (#ecf874) glowing terminal to a curious CRT monitor robot; code-plants grow beside them. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, never oversized, and strictly pixel art. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream background and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
